title: Case — Acumatica Integrated Partner Marketing Organization

text.content: Cloud ERP where VARs/ISVs/OEMs participate materially in sales and implementation.

rich_text.plain_text: Cloud ERP where VARs/ISVs/OEMs participate materially in sales and implementation.

text.content: Acumatica's Resource Center combines content, webinars, case studies, customer testimonials, Campaigns in a Box and a Partner Marketing Toolkit. Its 2026 SOC 3 report describes partner marketing, campaigns, product marketing, field events, digital marketing and corporate communications as elements of the marketing organization, while stating that products are sold primarily through partners.
